changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/4795-bindable-text-keys.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > Published authoring guidance updated to match: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` (new "Bindable Text Keys" rule), plus the `page-builder`, `schema-expressions` and `data-integration` guides, which taught the now-retired "never evaluated" statement and its host-pre-resolution workaround.

### `.changeset/6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > `bind` was read by ten production sites and declared by no schema shape. It resolved as `any` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature and rode `.passthrough()` on the validator, while three separate documents taught it as an authorable key of *every* node: this repo's own `AGENTS.md` §4 ("Every node in the UI tree follows this shape (`@object-ui/types`)"), the published agent-facing `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` ("Every UI component node MUST follow this shape"), and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`. So the agent-facing protocol told authors to write a key the published types did not know existed.

### `.changeset/6575-data-table-bind-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The platform was already paying for this in teaching rather than in diagnostics: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` documents the pothole verbatim and a pin test locks the behaviour. The warning now also reaches the console, where the author who did not read the docs is standing:

### `.changeset/6665-data-table-non-array-data-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The spelling that opened the card is a `${...}` expression string, and it is a defect rather than a design because the SAME expression is evaluated one key over. Re-measured on merge-base `5967be095` through the real `SchemaRenderer` (the table was previously quoted from `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` as a measurement on `f1c27f037` and had not been re-run); all four legs reproduced, and they are now pinned as tests rather than prose:

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `138ad4554` (merge-base with origin/main): 1 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1955 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2576 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36944473779)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a93c1a9bfcb7590e7dcb8201579c21bff0af713c`
Local-runs: none

Face: governed rule text (`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, objectui `skills/**`), reviewed in-seat by the dispatching seat at the constant's tier (skills lane, at tier). Inputs: objectui#11009 (body and every comment: the filer's addendum 5874144163, the triage grade 5874709199, the unlock 5923309483, the dev report 5943105309), PR #11410's body, its file list (2 files) and patch against `main` at `138ad4554`, and the check-runs on this head as read at this record.

### ① Derived judgments

1. The diff rewrites one clause of one line (`protocol.md`, the 「Readers only.」 line, 1 insertion / 1 deletion). Every other byte of the paragraph, the two fenced blocks its pins read, and the rest of the file are unchanged: the claim's file surface holds. RIGHT.
2. The clause now states three things, each read by this reviewer on objectui `origin/main` `7728c67`: (a) a `bind` on `data-table` is ignored and the header renders over an empty body — the unchanged half, still true (`data-table` reads an inline `data` array, not `useDataScope`); (b) the one signal is a render-time console warning prefixed `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` — `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/dataTableBindDiagnostic.ts` exists and `packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx` pins exactly one warning per bound table; (c) the parser tier draws no `unknown-prop` because `bind` is a base prop every node may carry — `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` has `BASE_PROPS = basePropNames('every-node')` and the row `{ name: 'bind', scope: 'every-node' }`, pinned by `bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx`. RIGHT on all three; the clause agrees with the `BaseSchema.bind` docblock in `packages/types/src/base.ts`.
3. The two issue citations inside published skill prose follow the file's own convention: `protocol.md` on `main` already carries nine `objectui#NNNN` citations, and objectui runs no tracker-number gate over `skills/**`. RIGHT, consistent.
4. No accept-set or public-surface change: no schema, validator or renderer code moves. The published catalog's reader (an AI author) gets a true description of an authoring trap in place of a false "silent" one. RIGHT.
5. Line budget read off the patch: the file 370 → 370 (one line replaced in place); the bundle 4806 → 4806; the new `.changeset` file adds four lines outside the skills tree. RIGHT; objectui has no skills token ratchet to read.

### ② Semver level

Docs-only in a governed surface; no package `files[]` content moves. The changeset is objectui's EMPTY-frontmatter form for a non-publishing change, and the phantom `skip-changeset` label is correctly not applied. `Clause-②: no` is right: nothing is accepted or rejected differently. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation — the PR assignee write was refused by the dev's own classifier before any request left the container: the assignee is the seat's write by protocol and the seat sets `os-elon-musk` in this stroke. Answered.
- Dev deviation — `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` for one invocation, because the container's Node `v22.22.0` sits under the `^22.22.2` floor `jsdom@30.0.1` declares and `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict=true`; no tracked file was touched and CI pins `22.x`. Accepted as a container reading; recorded on the seat post.
- Dev deviation — the turn ended on a server-side API 500 and resumed from the clean worktree with no redone work, no second worktree, no second claim. Accepted.
- Out-of-scope finding (class a, published text): `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` about `:258`–`:259` 「with nothing thrown and nothing logged」 is the same silence-clause family and false since objectui#6575. Escalated to the seat's filing: the seat enumerates the family's remaining sites and files ONE closure card in objectui, not a one-off. Not this PR's.
- Two 「noted, not filed」 items (a test-file header comment in `packages/types/src/__tests__/base-bind-declared.test.ts`; the container Node floor) stay noted.
- `open_questions`: none.
- Check-runs on `a93c1a9b` at this record: 0 `failure`; nine `in_progress` (eight `Test` shards and `Spec Main Shape Gate`), the rest `success` or path-skipped. The landing is Tier H: it waits on an authorized APPROVED review and on every check green, which the seat's landing window reads again on this head.

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位(skills 席 1,`session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`)对照自读的 diff 校正 dev 草稿后定稿,2026-10-02T00:18Z。

**改了什么。** 只改 `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` 「Readers only.」段落末尾的一个从句(同一行内重写,文件行数 370 → 370,整包 4806 → 4806)。原文说在 `data-table` 上写 `bind` 会「no error, no warning」;新文说:无错误、页面上无提示,唯一信号是渲染期的控制台警告 `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:`,解析层也不报 `unknown-prop`,因为 `bind` 是所有节点都可带的基础属性。示例与其它句子一字未动;另加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset(声明不发版)。

**为什么改。** 这份 skill 发布给写 objectui 元数据的作者(含 AI)。旧从句自 objectui#6575 起就是假的(渲染器会打一条警告);objectui#11008 落地后解析层半边也定型(`bind` 入基础属性,不再 `unknown-prop`)。教错的技能文本会让作者去找一个不存在的静默陷阱、或忽略真实存在的警告。`packages/types/src/base.ts` 的 `BaseSchema.bind` 文档已是真话并引用这一段,两处现在一致。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 纯文档改动,无代码、无发布包源码变动,行数净增 0。风险只在措辞是否精确:三个断言席位都在 objectui `main` 上复读过,其中两条机制断言各有一条既存 pin 测试覆盖(22/22 绿)。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的单个 commit,无残留。

**席位意见。** 建议批准。席内达档契约复核 PASS(见本 PR 评论);措辞与 `base.ts` 一致,引用编号沿用本文件既有惯例(文件内原有 9 处 objectui#N 引用)。同族的另一处假句(`guides/data-integration.md`「nothing thrown and nothing logged」)不在本 PR,席位另立一张全族收口卡。

**你要做的(一个动作)。** 在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review(`os-zhuang` / `hotlong` 任一)。之后由席位清标、翻 ready、挂 auto-merge 入队;不需要你合并。
